question: Where is the nearest restaurant found on the northeast side of Adventure Sports in Hershey, Hershey, PA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Hershey%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Adventure Sports in Hershey%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 -- Northeast range ORDER BY ST_Distance( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Adventure Sports in Hershey%' LIMIT 1)::geography, p.geometry::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
